reason: This is a planner-core semantic change, not a local fix: it alters how index join probe side is classified and propagated through physical properties/path selection (`indexJoinProp`, `find_best_task`, exhaust plan generation, physical plans/properties). That can change join plan enumeration and chosen access path across many queries, with real risk of wrong plan selection or executor mismatch/regression. The planner core/property files plus updated physical plan golden output make it central and high-blast-radius enough for a focused deep review.
